user_instruction: No macro-specific execution logic; macro output shares the ordinary expression and pattern engine

findings.title: Independent assertion expression evaluator
findings.consequence: Assertion arguments are reparsed into a synthetic wrapper and interpreted by a separate AST work stack. Arithmetic, calls, borrowing, match and if are duplicated rather than using ordinary indexed expressions.
findings.required_repair: Expand selected macro definitions and attach their output to the common entered source/body graph; execute generated expressions with ordinary thunks and runtime operations.

findings.title: Pattern semantics split across three contexts
findings.consequence: Ordinary match, scalar let conditions, and assertion-nested patterns use separate lowerers. vm/pattern.rs implements binding-mode rules but is not a complete shared traversal/transaction/guard engine.
findings.required_repair: Implement one source-selected pattern plan and transactional runtime path shared by match, if-let/while-let, let-else and generated Rust; retain source editions and alternative retry/cleanup.

findings.title: Numeric inference depends on assertion macro identity
findings.consequence: A local-to-parameter numeric relation is inferred only through recognized assert_eq/assert_ne operands, rather than from common lowered source constraints.
findings.required_repair: Derive numeric relationships from ordinary expanded expressions and selected source member signatures; macro identity cannot select inference rules.

findings.title: Generated expression output only executes as a literal
findings.consequence: After a real macro expansion is decoded, only a literal or parentheses are accepted and a bespoke literal recipe is installed. Nonliteral output bypasses no generic body lowering and is refused.
findings.required_repair: Publish all generated expression syntax/origins into the ordinary entered-body representation and lower its actual nodes; preserve captured caller bindings, hygiene and continuation.

findings.title: Generated statements have a special break executor
findings.consequence: Statement output receives a direct-break/scalar-payload decoder and special caller-target admission; other statement forms remain a separate pending route.
findings.required_repair: Resolve generated labels and bindings through the common source/hygiene graph, then use ordinary control-flow and cleanup; retain the actual origin/currentness checks during migration.

findings.title: Methods are whitelisted inside the assertion evaluator
findings.consequence: Committed source handles is_nan in the assertion evaluator. The held cumulative candidate adds len/as_bytes/is_empty/contains there. Ordinary method syntax is not routed through a common reached member service by these paths. Source/type checks exist, but the macro-only entry point is still wrong.
findings.required_repair: Select methods through ordinary source member resolution and execute the selected body or audited runtime operation identically in every expression context.

findings.title: Known macro catalogue selects execution semantics instead of source expansion
findings.consequence: Macro identities select special assertion/panic routes and custom vec argument grammar; vec/println then reach explicit unsupported dispatch branches. Identity checking avoids same-name confusion but does not make this a common expansion/execution design.
findings.required_repair: Resolve and expand actual macro definitions through the common macro pipeline. Compiler expansion hooks remain in the pinned adapter; generated runtime code uses the common engine and selected library calls.

findings.title: Body index and verifier have assertion-only execution tracks
findings.consequence: Opaque macro nodes reserve a token-derived parallel slot/phase namespace and require separate scalar-call/borrow/exhaustion verifier entry points. This entrenches the secondary evaluator. This review does not establish an authority bypass.
findings.required_repair: Index generated ordinary nodes and verify their normal operation/source roles. Remove obsolete exceptions only after their source identity, lifetime, fuel and capability guarantees are covered by common-path regressions.

review_scope: frozen V122/V123 cumulative source where explicitly identified
scope_limits: source review, not a new runtime reproduction
not an exhaustive proof that no further special cases exist
test-only fixture helpers were checked against cfg(test) module boundaries and are not reported as production fixture hard-coding
separate pure constant evaluation is explicitly required by spec18.3; its existence alone is not classified as a defect

minimal_witness.source: macro_rules! expression { () => { 1_i32 + 2_i32 }; } fn main() { let _value = expression!(); }
minimal_witness.observation: committed expression-expansion route admits only Literal/ParenExpr and rejects the generated BinExpr
